simple.meaning: קִרְאָה (qirʼâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “an encountering , accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite ).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 100 times in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 14:17. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִרְאָה (H7125) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קִרְאָה (qirʼâh) / H7125 is traced through Genesis 14:17, Genesis 15:10, Genesis 18:2, Genesis 19:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.
